data.body: **[P2] Propagate fatal MDC restoration failures to the invocation caller.** If asynchronous `restore.close()` throws `VirtualMachineError` or `ThreadDeath`, this `finally` completes `result` with the previously selected output/failure, so the fatal escapes only the worker and Lambda may return success. Complete `result` exceptionally with the fatal—preserving suppression and fatal precedence—before rethrowing it from the worker, and update the asynchronous restoration test to assert the caller observes the same fatal.
